title: R3 (h, fuzzer e2): rows ending at the last column with a wide CJK char, an emoji and an invalid UTF-8 byte, then quit and reopen: the replayed screen equals the daemon's
why: Lawrence's v2.2.11-opt capture (2026-10-31): grid 297x87 but fit_grid 126x87 in a 2088x1233 view. After a resize the shown terminal must have one size in the app, Ghostty, the PTY and the daemon, and a typed long line must wrap at it. Fuzzer e2 (vt_fuzz_finding_e2, STATUS 2039): the attach replay drew a row with a wide or broken character at the right edge in the wrong place.
source: cmux-ad P0 2026-10-31 (Lawrence on v2.2.11-opt: resizing terminals is broken); R3 invariant

steps.title: set-up: the window at 70% x 70% of the screen
baseline: the terminal fits the placed window (R3, settled)

steps.text: c=$(tput cols); f() { printf '%*s' $((c-$2)) '' | tr ' ' "$1"; }; for i in 1 2 3; do f a 2; printf '\346\274\242'; f b 1; printf '\360\237\230\200'; f c 1; printf '\377'; f d 1; printf '\346\274\242x'; echo; done; echo e2done-${nonce}

steps.title: after the reattach: the replayed screen is the live one, and one size everywhere
